description: Supervisor / planner agent — reads a task, picks tools from a bounded YAML-declared set, and fans out execution across per-tool Dagster assets. Ends with a synthesizer LLM that grounds the final answer in tool outputs. The 'agent of agents' pattern with full lineage.

inputs.description: Task is provided in YAML config.

outputs.description: Emits (2 + N_tools) assets: plan, one per tool, and synthesis.

synthesis_asset_name.label: Synthesis Asset Name
synthesis_asset_name.description: Name of the final synthesis asset.

task.label: Task
task.description: The task / question the supervisor plans against.

model.label: Model
model.description: Optional per-tool model override. When None (default), the component-level `model` is used for this tool. Set this to use a search-capable model (e.g., 'perplexity/sonar-pro' via Vercel AI Gateway) for tools that need real web / retrieval, while keeping cheap models for arithmetic-style tools.

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Per-tool API key env var override (defaults to component-level).

api_base_env_var.label: API Base Env Var
api_base_env_var.description: Per-tool base URL env var override — e.g., set to `VERCEL_AI_GATEWAY_URL` for a search-capable route. Defaults to component-level.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.
